verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows publishers sending simulcast or layered video, or the relay picking a layer for each subscriber based on their bandwidth. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: sender-side stream prioritization that lets new groups and audio starve old video, and custom tracks as a building block. A community question about client-side adaptive bitrate (ABR) in HLS/DASH also does not show MoQ doing it.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, publishers send layered or simulcast video and the service adapts the layer each subscriber receives to their bandwidth
